records.quote: Lemma 6 (Li and Fang [20]) For two n-dimensional Archimedean copulas Cψ1 (u) and Cψ2 (u), if φ2 ◦ ψ1 is super-additive then Cψ1 ≤c Cψ2 , i.e. Cψ1 (u) ≤ Cψ2 (u) for all u ∈ [0, 1]n .
records.family: Archimedean copulas with generators ψ1, ψ2 (φ = ψ^{-1})
records.compared: concordance order between two Archimedean copulas
records.ambiguity: Quoted from Li and Fang; engine for all dependent-case results.

b_records.quote: Theorem 9 Let {X1,...,Xn} and {Y1,...,Yn} be two sets of independent random variables each following the multiple outlier LS model such that Xi ∼ LS(λ1, σ1, F), Yi ∼ LS(λ1, ξ1, F) for i = 1,...,n1 and Xi ∼ LS(λ2, σ2, F), Yi ∼ LS(λ2, ξ2, F) for i = n1+1,...,n. Suppose that (λ1,λ2), (σ1,σ2), (ξ1,ξ2) ∈ D+ (or E+). Now if urX(u) is decreasing in u and rX(u) is log-concave and 2-log-convex in u, then (1/σ1·n1, 1/σ2·n2) ≼m (1/ξ1·n1, 1/ξ2·n2) ⇒ X1:n ≥R−hr Y1:n.
b_records.model: series systems, multiple-outlier model, common baseline
b_records.family: LS family with common baseline F
b_records.compared: minima in R-hr order under majorization of reciprocal scales
